name: -6AN Flare Tee w/ 1/8" NPT Port
title: -6AN Flare Tee w/ 1/8" NPT Port
description:
The -6AN Flare Tee w/ 1/8" NPT Port is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Flare Tee Fittings with 1/8" NPT Port are precision-engineered to split your AN plumbing line into a T-configuration while simultaneously providing a 1/8" NPT side port for connecting a pressure or temperature sensor, delivering a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
